info.name: Ibraheem Altamim API
info.description:
Laravel API collection.

**Variables** (Collection → Variables):
- `base_url` = http://ibraheemaltamim.test
- `token` = JWT from Login or Verify email (Bearer)

Protected folders inherit Bearer {{token}}. Paste token after auth.

request.description: Creates user. Sends OTP to email.
Use actual notification id values from your DB.
Can use form-urlencoded or raw JSON with same keys.
Only while status is pending. Optional documents[].
